bindings.varsNote: These are the runtime flags that decide what Production actually does, so they belong in the manifest rather than only in wrangler.jsonc. TRAFFIC_SOURCE_MODE=PBS_ONLY stops every TDX API call; LINE_PUSH_POLICY=MAJOR_ACCIDENT_ONLY narrows proactive LINE push to accidents; PBS_AI_DECISION_ENABLED gates Windows PBS AI driver-impact decisions (must be the string 'true' to activate, never a bare JSON boolean -- Cloudflare injects Workers Variables as strings). All three are substituted from wrangler.jsonc by the export script, never hardcoded here. V2.0.2: PBS_AI_DECISION_ENABLED's canonical source moved from a Dashboard-only Variable (silently dropped by every Workers Builds deploy) to this wrangler.jsonc declaration -- see PRODUCT_DECISIONS.md / 07_KNOWN_ISSUES.md for the Config Drift Hotfix history. V2.4.0 added three granular switches (TDX_ROADEVENT_FETCH_ENABLED/TDX_ROADEVENT_QUEUE_INGRESS_ENABLED/TDX_CCTV_METADATA_REFRESH_ENABLED, all default "false"); V2.4.1 added a fourth, TDX_ROADEVENT_PRODUCTION_NOTIFY_ENABLED (also default "false" when first built). On 2026-09-01 (V2_4_1_PRODUCTION_NOTIFY_CANONICAL_RECONCILIATION), FETCH/QUEUE_INGRESS/PRODUCTION_NOTIFY were all set "true" under explicit human authorization. V2.4.4 (2026-09-02, TDX_SCOPE_POLICY_AND_MESSAGE_FIDELITY_FIX): a real service-area leak (台61線 39.6K, actually Taoyuan) plus routine-road-management/message-fidelity defects were found and fixed at the code layer (see 07_KNOWN_ISSUES.md), and TDX_ROADEVENT_PRODUCTION_NOTIFY_ENABLED was deliberately reverted to "false" as this round's own safety deliverable -- FETCH/QUEUE_INGRESS stay "true" so Production continues to observe real TDX data through the new gate/policy fixes; re-enabling notify requires a separate future human+Claude Browser decision after that observation. TDX_CCTV_METADATA_REFRESH_ENABLED remains "false" (CCTV metadata refresh stays manual/on-demand). V2.4.5 (2026-09-02, TDX_HSINCHU_GEO_RESOLVER + TDX_ROAD_MANAGEMENT_POLICY_GATE): replaced V2.4.4's denylist-only service-area patch with a genuine official-boundary-backed positive-authority resolver plus a deterministic road-management policy gate (see v245TdxHsinchuGeoResolver below) -- these three switches deliberately stay exactly as V2.4.4 left them (FETCH/QUEUE_INGRESS "true", PRODUCTION_NOTIFY "false"); this round's own deliverable is the geography/policy fix itself, not a switch flip.

v245TdxHsinchuGeoResolver.note: V2.4.5 (2026-09-02, MINOR). Core acceptance: TDX must positively prove an event is inside 新竹市 or 新竹縣 before entering AI; inability to prove means no AI entry. PBS entirely out of scope.
v245TdxHsinchuGeoResolver.geoResolver: New src/tdx/hsinchuGeoResolver.js#resolveTdxHsinchuGeography() -- three-state CONFIRMED_HSINCHU/OUTSIDE_HSINCHU/UNKNOWN, never a boolean. Only the coordinate tier (checked against the real official 內政部國土測繪中心 boundary polygon, data.gov.tw dataset 7442, mirrored via the taiwan-atlas npm package -- this sandbox cannot reach data.gov.tw directly, human decision recorded in 07_KNOWN_ISSUES.md) can positively confirm. The old KM heuristic table is demoted to observability-only. UNKNOWN behaves exactly like OUTSIDE_HSINCHU downstream (0 Queue/0 AI/0 LINE) -- never assumed Hsinchu.
v245TdxHsinchuGeoResolver.boundaryData: BOUNDARY_AUTHORITY=內政部國土測繪中心, BOUNDARY_DATASET=直轄市、縣市界線（TWD97經緯度）, BOUNDARY_DATASET_ID=7442, BOUNDARY_SOURCE_CRS=TWD97經緯度(EPSG:3824), BOUNDARY_INCLUDED_AREAS=新竹市,新竹縣, BOUNDARY_FETCH_DATE=2026-09-02T13:05:01Z, BOUNDARY_SOURCE_VERSION=taiwan-atlas npm 2021.9.20 (counties-10t.json, MIT license), BOUNDARY_TRANSFORMATION=none (TDX PositionLon/Lat treated as WGS84; TWD97 vs WGS84 differ by centimeters for Taiwan, this project's own pre-existing engineering precedent, not a guess about the boundary geometry). Full provenance in data/hsinchu-boundary/raw/SOURCE_META.json.
v245TdxHsinchuGeoResolver.roadManagementPolicyGate: New src/tdx/roadManagementPolicyGate.js#resolveTdxRoadManagementEligibility(), runs AFTER the geography gate, BEFORE Queue.send(). Dynamic shoulder open/close never eligible; routine construction eligible only when blockedLanes>=2 (missing/unparseable/negative/fractional -> ineligible, fail-closed). Escape valve (reusing anomalyClassification.js#detectNonCollisionAnomaly plus a narrow accident/complete-closure keyword check) prevents a genuinely major event from being falsely blocked by the routine-construction rule.
v245TdxHsinchuGeoResolver.gateOrdering: tdxQueueIngress.js#enqueueTdxRoadEvents() now runs the geography gate first, then the road-management gate, before any Queue.send() -- new droppedOutsideHsinchu/droppedUnknownHsinchu/droppedRoadManagement observability counters. serviceArea.js's TDX branch delegates to the same resolveTdxHsinchuGeography(), so aiCandidate.js's Gate 2 and the existing V2.4.4 Gate 3 in aiApprovedPbsBroadcast.js automatically use the identical canonical result -- no new code needed for the pre-LINE re-check (Gate B).
v245TdxHsinchuGeoResolver.aiInputChange: blockedLanes added to aiCandidate.js#buildAiCandidate()/aiDecisionEngine.js#buildAiUserPrompt() as a structured field (always present, null when absent -- same shape as the existing displayKM field). PBS candidates always carry blockedLanes:null (PBS never sets it) -- purely additive, verified byte-shape change only.
